claim: The AutoML model reports precision 0.850, recall 0.616, F1 0.701, and 82.7% of sites in the top three.

claim: The untrained geometric baseline already puts a positive pocket in the top three for 84.3% of test proteins.
quote: For 70.6% of the total 204 proteins used in our study, the top-ranked pocket among the pockets detected is positive in our labeling method. For 84.3% of proteins in the test set, the positive pockets are among the top three ranked positions.

claim: Training data is 90 ASD proteins with pocket-level labels.
quote: For the 90 proteins from ASD, a pocket is labeled as either 1 (positive) if it contains at least one residue identified as binding to allosteric modulators or 0 (negative) if it does not contain such residues.

claim: AlloPred, normal-mode perturbation plus pocket descriptors in an ML ranker, gets 23/40 top-1 and 28/40 top-2.
quote: AlloPred ranked an allosteric pocket top for 23 out of 40 known allosteric proteins, showing comparable and complementary performance to two existing methods. In 28 of 40 cases an allosteric pocket was ranked first or second.
